name: Holding screen — calm gradient with time and date (portrait)
description: A quiet standby screen: a large, light clock and the date over a soft gradient, with an optional small logo and one line of text. Six bundled gradients, your timezone and language. Easy on the eye for screens that sit idle for hours. Portrait 9:16 layout.
author: ScreenTinker

params.name: palette
params.label: Gradient
params.help: The background wash. All six are dark enough for light text.

params.name: timezone
params.label: Timezone
params.help: Where the clock and date are for. Leave empty to use the screen's own clock.

params.name: locale
params.label: Language
params.help: How the time and date are written, e.g. en-GB, de-DE or fr-CA. Leave empty for the screen's language.

params.name: message
params.label: Line of text
params.help: A small line along the bottom. Leave empty for none.
params.default: Northwind Studio  ·  Visitors please sign in at the front desk

params.name: show_logo
params.label: Show the logo
params.help: A small logo at the bottom.

params.name: logo
params.label: Logo
params.help: A light (white) PNG or SVG with a transparent background reads best on the gradient.

params.name: text_color
params.label: Text colour
params.help: Clock, date and the line of text. Keep it light: every gradient is dark.
